summary.text: Braxton Seifert is the Republican candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 15 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
According to his campaign website, he is a loan officer at a family-owned bank who has built businesses and bought a farm site in southwest Minnesota.

paragraphs.text: Seifert says on his campaign website that he and his family are six generations deep in Senate District 15 and that his relatives came to southwest Minnesota for opportunity.
He writes that he has invested his future in the region by buying a farm site, raising chickens, building his businesses and working as a loan officer at a family-owned bank.
Ballotpedia lists him as advancing from the canceled August 11, 2026 Republican primary without appearing on the ballot.
